description: This file defines the PdfAnnotations class, which manages a collection of PDF annotations for a page, including adding, removing, clearing, and enumerating annotations within a PDF document.

classes.name: PdfAnnotations
classes.description: Represents a collection of annotations on a PDF page, providing methods to manipulate annotations.

classes.name: AnnotationsIterator
classes.description: Enumerator class for iterating over the annotations collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new annotation to the collection and associates it with the document and owner.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specified annotation from the collection, ensuring it belongs to the current document.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all annotations from the current page.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Accesses the annotation at the specified index, creating a generic annotation if necessary.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating through the annotations collection.
